notes: The possessive of 'man's' is read as part of the substantival adjective's rendering with its supplied generic (rule 31), leaving the resumptive suffix on 'eyes' unrepresented; the competing reading gives t003 to that suffix and leaves חָכָם the bare 'wise'.
s023 takes 'to' as the preposition through which the English verb reaches its object (rule 16); s024 keeps only 'all' while the suffix takes 'them' (rule 19).
